description: This file implements the PagedAttention class for handling large batch size attention inference with memory optimization, built on top of flex_attention. It includes methods for reserving pages, erasing batches, assigning key/value tensors, and converting logical to physical block masks.

classes.name: PagedAttention
classes.description: A class supporting large batch size attention inference with memory-efficient paged key/value storage.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing paged attention parameters and metadata.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Reserves memory pages for a batch based on sequence length.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes a batch from paged attention, freeing its pages.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns key/value tensors into the cache at specified positions.

methods.name: convert_logical_block_mask
methods.description: Converts a logical block mask to physical indices using the page table.

methods.name: get_mask_mod
methods.description: Creates a mask modification function based on physical-to-logical index mapping.

methods.name: get_score_mod
methods.description: Creates a score modification function based on physical-to-logical index mapping.
